findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a pull request runs the six test groups on the existing runners.
The Done-when requires: “The slowest of the six pull request test groups finishes in about 5 minutes on a normal run, with the same six groups and the same runners.” This change only enables timing reports; it does not reduce test execution time. The latest commit explicitly confirms that no measured performance repair or refreshed hardware durations exist. Its 36–82-second diagnostic jobs selected related tests and are acknowledged as incomparable to the earlier baseline. The requested performance outcome therefore remains unmet; complete the measured repair and demonstrate comparable normal group times.
